subject: Jerin
text: A player reports the Jerin achievement stayed blocked on the website after unlocking in game, at about 80% through the story.

evidence.quote: [Kyshme] Apparently this unlock bugged me. The achievement unlocked icon appeared and I continued with my save, but when I accessed the website it remained blocked. I'm already well advanced in the story, about 80% of the game, unlocking the previous and later achievements, but this one unfortunately remains blocked.

subject: Might Helmet
object: Enter the Tower of Light right after getting the ship
text: A commenter says the Might Helmet cannot be obtained unless the Tower of Light is entered right after getting the ship, before anything else is triggered.

evidence.quote: [Madawk] Enter the Tower of Light before triggering anything (as soon as you get the ship). Otherwise, you won't be able to get this item.

subject: Might Helmet
text: A commenter says the Might Helmet can be obtained as a drop.

evidence.quote: [Schengo] U can get the Helmet via Drop

subject: Might Helmet
text: The Might Helmet (MH) is at the top of the Tower of Light.

evidence.quote: [RetroSprites] The MH is in the top of the tower.

subject: Bakku
text: A commenter advises players not to visit Bakku until they have the Might Helmet.

evidence.quote: [permafrosty] Just don't visit bakku until you get this

subject: Might Helmet
object: go directly to the Tower of Light after getting the ship
text: After getting the ship, players must go directly to the Tower of Light and take the helmet from the top floor, since the trigger is easy to miss.

evidence.quote: Heads up, the trigger for this is unintuitive and very easy to miss. Upon getting the ship, you must go *directly* to the Tower of Light and get the helmet from the top floor.

subject: Might Helmet
text: Visiting the town of Bakku on the way to the Tower of Light makes the Might Helmet disappear forever.

evidence.quote: There is a town on the way called Bakku that looks like a great place to heal and save, and if you do, the helmet disappears forever.

subject: Might Helmet
text: A Portuguese commenter says they had visited Bakku but not yet found Carbon in the cave when they got the helmet.

evidence.quote: quando eu fiz , eu ainda n tinha ido encontra carbom na caverna porem eu ja havia ido em bakku
evidence.translation: when I did it, I still had not gone to find carbon in the cave, but I had already gone to Bakku

subject: Sweet Waters
text: Sweet Waters can avoid nearly all random encounters in the Tower of Light, even at level 25.

evidence.quote: Even as low as level 25, Sweet Waters can be used to avoid basically all random encounters in the Light Tower, so you're not in any real risk if you rush the helmet as soon as you get the Falcon.

subject: Old Cave last floor
text: The last floor of the Old Cave opens at level 30.

evidence.quote: [anndodo] The last floor opens on lvl 30
